blocks.text: Taiwan Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung joined U.S. officials in opening Taiwan’s new representative office in Phoenix, his ministry said Tuesday, as Taiwanese technology companies boost investment in Arizona. More than 200 people attended Monday’s ceremony, including Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs, Phoenix Mayor Kate Gallego, Taiwanese expat community leaders and representatives of the island’s companies such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., the ministry said. TSMC, the world’s largest contract chipmaker, has been building a semiconductor manufacturing complex in Arizona, with planned total investment reaching $265 billion.
